allein.g: alone; not the only one doing it ('nicht allein')

am.g: at the; contraction of an + dem

an.g: at, on; here, standing at the till

automat.g: short for Geldautomat, a cash machine

bar.g: in cash; to pay with notes and coins ('bar zahlen')

bargeld.g: cash; literally 'ready money', notes and coins

barzahlung.g: a cash payment; the term banking reports use

befragten.g: the respondents; the people a survey asked

bei.g: at, with; in the case of a coffee ('bei einem Kaffee')

danach.g: after that; next in the ranking

datenschutz.g: data protection; privacy as a legal principle, a German preoccupation

dauert.g: takes (dauern); lasts a given amount of time

derselben.g: of the same; of those very respondents ('derselben Befragten')

einschränken.g: to restrict; to allow something only within limits

erleichtere.g: makes easier (erleichtern); the subjunctive form marks reported speech

findet.g: finds (finden); here, thinks or holds an opinion

ganz.g: quite, entirely; right at the top ('ganz oben')

geht.g: goes (gehen); it is quicker ('es geht schneller')

gemacht.g: made, done (machen); here forms the passive with wird

gut.g: well; before a number, 'a good', slightly more than

handel.g: trade, retail; here, shops taken as a sector

hin.g: towards; splits off from hinhalten, to hold out to someone

jede.g: every, each; every other one ('jede zweite')

kasse.g: the till; the counter where you pay

kein.g: no, not a; negates a noun

kommt.g: comes (kommen); here, comes next in the list

man.g: one, people in general; the impersonal subject

nachgerechnet.g: worked out (nachrechnen); redid the arithmetic to check

oben.g: at the top; ranks first ('steht ganz oben')

rundungsfehler.g: a rounding error; something too small to be worth noticing

schein.g: a banknote; paper money as opposed to coins

schlicht.g: simply, plainly; no more complicated than that

schwarzarbeit.g: undeclared work, paid in cash and hidden from the tax office

solle.g: should (sollen); the subjunctive form marks reported speech

sondern.g: but rather; corrects the negative just stated

steht.g: stands (stehen); ranks at the top ('steht oben')

stromausfall.g: a power cut; when the electricity fails and card terminals die with it

stur.g: stubborn; refusing to budge, said with mild irritation

technik.g: technology; the machines and systems themselves

tresen.g: the counter of a bar or café, the surface you stand at to order

unterschrift.g: signature; here, the one on a card receipt

verrät.g: gives away (verraten); reveals what was meant to stay private

widerspruch.g: a contradiction; holding two positions that cannot both stand

wird.g: becomes, is (werden); here it builds the passive

zweite.g: second; every other payment ('jede zweite Zahlung')

überhaupt.g: at all; widens a question to what a thing even is
